scenes.vo: Page eighteen of a two-hundred-and-forty-six page government file. A thirteen-hundred-megawatt coal expansion skipped its public hearing.
Page twenty-five: recommended. Nobody objected. Nobody could read it.
AI agents on Amazon Bedrock read every page, and prove every number against the source.
Then they tell the people next door what is being approved. In plain words. In Hindi.
And help them object, legally, before it is too late.
Read the filing before it is approved.
